preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 5,000,000.
The integer k is between 1 and the length of the string s.
All characters in the string s are lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The length of the resulting string s' is equal to the length of the original string s.
The resulting string s' is lexicographically smaller than or equal to the original string s.

postconditions.expression: return_value == min((t1 + t2[::-1] + ... + tm[::-1]) for i in range(k) for t1, t2, ..., tm in [s[:i], s[i:j], ..., s[j:]])
postconditions.description: The resulting string s' is the lexicographically smallest string obtainable by splitting s into at most k non-empty substrings and reversing some of them.
